summary: Pressure pushes an unknown reality with each swallow Pain ensconced in a room while desire to teach drives me no thought follows locked away from family awaiting for truth dripping on a stick I shoved up my nose #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Pressure
pushes
an unknown
reality with
each swallow

Pain
ensconced
in a room
while
desire to teach
drives me
no thought
follows
locked away
from family
awaiting for truth
dripping on a
stick
I shoved up
my nose
#smallpoems
